date_note: The page gives only its own publication day (23 November); it says users were notified that day.
title: European Commission says cyberattack disrupted EU Academy platform and leaked user data
summary: An agency report carried by Shorouk News says the European Commission announced that its EU Academy online learning platform was disrupted by a cyberattack that leaked personal data of registered users. The report says this is part of a campaign against Commission systems disclosed the previous week. Spokesperson Thomas Regnier said users were notified on the Academy website. The report gives no figures or return date.
plain: The European Commission says an attack disrupted its EU Academy learning platform and leaked registered users' personal data, according to an agency report carried by Shorouk News.
exec: The Commission says user data from an EU platform leaked; the report ties it to an earlier campaign against Commission systems.
action: As the Commission's spokesperson says, users were notified through the EU Academy website; check that notice. General advice: be alert to phishing that uses your registration details.

validation.note: Only the Shorouk News agency report was read (Arabic); it quotes the Commission spokesperson. The Commission's own page (learning.ec.europa.eu) could not be loaded.
